name: Design packs
author: Brett
description: Candidate design packages for the default-look refactor, shown as one filterable grid of packs (newest round first). A row opens a large screenshot browser: screens listed on the left (a collapsible thumbnail strip on a phone), the preview on the right with previous / next that never scroll away and swipe left / right. Pick up to 3 packs; picks are saved on the console server and on axHub. Screenshots live in packs/<round>/, listed in packs/index.json.
